\title{SignalShap: Exact Ranking-Stage Source Attribution for Hybrid
Recommenders}

\author[ensias]{Mouad Louhichi\corref{cor1}}
\ead{mouad_louhichi@um5.ac.ma}
\author[ensias]{Redwane Nesmaoui}

\address[ensias]{National Higher School of Computer Science and Systems
Analysis (ENSIAS), Mohammed V University in Rabat, Rabat, Morocco}

\begin{highlights}
\item Exact Shapley attribution is computed over all 32 source coalitions.
\item Shapley and ranking-stage LOO disagree on two of three corpora.
\item Ranking-stage LOO better predicts observed source-retirement cost.
\item Fixed candidates separate ranking attribution from retrieval effects.
\item The method allocates source credit without prescribing source retirement.
\end{highlights}
